scenes.headline: How one knob slides from autoregression to diffusion
scenes.sub: Set Diffusion, from Arriola and Kuleshov at Cornell.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ferret! Autoregressive models can cache. Diffusion models run in parallel, in any order. Set Diffusion shows they sit on one spectrum, and slides along it.

scenes.text: Decode flexible-position, flexible-length token sets, in an order you choose. Autoregression, block diffusion and order-agnostic diffusion become special cases.
scenes.say: Decode flexible-position, flexible-length sets of tokens, in an order you choose. Autoregression, block diffusion and order-agnostic diffusion all become special cases.

steps.label: Autoregression
steps.say: Steps run down, positions across. Autoregression makes every set a single token, strictly left to right.

steps.label: Block diffusion
steps.say: Block diffusion decodes fixed contiguous blocks, left to right, denoising inside each block.

steps.label: Order-agnostic diffusion
steps.say: Order-agnostic diffusion is one set, the whole sequence, revealed in random order.

steps.label: Set diffusion
steps.note: one window width w sets the overlap
steps.say: Set diffusion slides a window: a few tokens per step, mostly in order. Narrow it and you get autoregression; widen it fully and you get diffusion.

scenes.title: Why sets keep the KV cache

left.title: Block diffusion
items: Fixed blocks, strictly left to right
Cache updates once a block finishes
left.say: Block diffusion needs two-way context inside a block, so its cache only updates when the block is done, and it can't infill.

right.title: Set diffusion
items: Each set sees itself and earlier sets
right.say: Set diffusion is set-causal: each set attends only to itself and earlier sets. Finished sets never change, so the cache updates every step.

scenes.title: GSM8K, 0-shot pass@1, 110M parameters
scenes.say: At a hundred and ten million parameters, set diffusion beats block diffusion on grade-school math, and decodes faster. A plain autoregressive model still scores highest.

scenes.text: Block size was the wrong knob. The order in which token sets are generated is the right one.
scenes.mark: the order in which token sets are generated

recap: AR, block and diffusion are set schedules
Set-causal attention updates the cache every step
scenes.say: To recap: three model families as set schedules, a cache that updates every step, and infilling for free.
